title: GenerationJob result manifest — academy-brain.generate-session
description: Shape of GenerationJobExecutionResult.ResultManifest on success for operation 'academy-brain.generate-session' (STEP 5). studioBuild.commitSha is the Studio repo commit CourseDeveloper.Worker ran under — per DEC-004 there is no separate academy-brain release to pin, so this replaces that idea. pedagogy is academy-brain's real pedagogy-coverage gate output (00-contracts/pedagogy.md §5), sourced by generate_session.pedagogy_summary() — never a guess — and is the DEC-005 transformation-summary evidence STEP 8's customer-facing receipt reads.

commitSha.description: Studio monorepo commit the worker/academy-brain subprocess ran under.

exitCode.description: generate_session.py's process exit code. 0 = success (or a clean dry run). 2 = HardStop (a gate refused; see stderrTail).

stdoutTail.description: Last N lines of the subprocess's stdout, for operator diagnosis. Not the full log — that belongs to the worker's own log sink.

receiptPath.description: Path to the .production.yaml receipt generate_session.write_receipt() wrote, when live=true and the run succeeded. Null for a dry run.

pedagogy.description: Real gates.REGISTRY['pedagogy-coverage'] output for sessionId's level. UNVERIFIED with a plain reason if that level has no pedagogy record yet (00-contracts/pedagogy.md §5) — never fabricated.
